haki.evidence: Zoro's timeskip flashback shows Mihawk teaching him to imbue swords with Haki so a blade takes no nicks.
At Marineford he tracks Luffy's high-speed Gear 2 movements through the chaos and strikes with precision, a feat the Boa sisters could not match.
In Udon he demonstrates and names Ryuo, striking down the Gifter Alpacaman without touching him.
He senses Luffy's presence atop the Skull Dome and realizes he is still alive.
His clash with fellow Emperor Big Mom produces the sky-splitting lightning burst that marks a Supreme King Haki collision; he explicitly names and infuses it in 1010.
He overpowers Luffy's hardened arms with his own Armament Haki and projects it off his kanabo in the Hakai attack; Law also states Kaidou's Haki is too strong to move.
He senses the 'voices' of the downed Super Rookies after the Hakai attack and knows they are still alive.

results.note: Conqueror corrected earlier than the scraped 923 hint, which cited a raw-strength knockout rather than a Haki display.

haki.evidence: After the unconscious Luffy knocks out Kaidou's men with Supreme King Haki, Ashura Doji states on-page that this was Oden's power.
Tenguyama explains that Enma drains its wielder's Ryuo and that Oden alone could tame it, establishing him as a master Armament user.
Only sourced to his Vivre Card; anchored to the end of his flashback at his execution, after which no further Oden feats are shown.

haki.evidence: Gyukimaru explains that Shusui became a permanent Black Blade in Ryuma's hands, a transformation the series attributes to Armament Haki.

results.note: The Black Blade to Haki link is only fully spelled out later (Sukiyaki in 955, Zoro's Enma in 1033), so a stricter reading would date this to 955.
